tools.name: analyze
tools.title: Analyze media
tools.description: Analyze attached or existing media using instruction or a saved prompt. Root files are native attachments; source selects existing media or a direct import; destination is only for new media. Omit files/source to open the picker. Returns analysis_id, progress, incremental accepted-part JSON and direct segment downloads. Retain the ID and follow next_action until terminal within host/user controls; after_seconds is a polling interval, not an ETA. Local transfers use the configured request timeout; observation is bounded to 30 seconds after upload. Download JSON/clips directly without OAuth headers; claim a file was saved only after saving succeeds.

files.description: Host-provided attachments; pass descriptors unchanged. At most eight files, each at most 2 GiB.

file_paths.description: Local stdio paths within configured upload roots.

destination.description: Destination for new media only. Name creates or reuses an index; omit for Playground.

processing_model.description: Model ID published by the billing pricing API.

signing_secret.description: Caller-provided verification secret; never include it in results or logs.

webhook.description: Direct integrations only. One terminal notification for this task; no account-wide subscription.

wait_seconds.description: Maximum observation time, not processing duration. Processing continues after this call ends.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and identical arguments after uncertain submission; new work uses a new key.

detail.description: Prefer summary and the complete JSON download; full is a bounded inline fallback.

segment_downloads.description: Direct clip downloads. All available segment links are also included in the JSON. Follow redirects without OAuth headers.

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.title: Get analysis
tools.description: Read progress or results without rerunning analysis. Use analysis_id, or video_id for its latest complete analysis. Wait at most 30 seconds for progress; no revision argument is needed. Follow next_action using the same ID. Accepted parts are available while other parts continue; media and image indexing may finish after extraction. Refresh expired JSON/clip grants here, or use full detail with page_size/cursor when files are unavailable.

wait_seconds.description: Maximum observation time, not processing duration. Processing continues after this call ends.

detail.description: Prefer summary and the complete JSON download; full is a bounded inline fallback.

segment_downloads.description: Direct clip downloads. All available segment links are also included in the JSON. Follow redirects without OAuth headers.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search media
tools.description: Search extracted results with text, an image, metadata filters, or a combination. Filters apply before ranking. A new search requires scope selecting one library, videos, Playground, or historical analyses. Library/video scopes use latest complete results per video. max_results bounds the saved match set; page_size bounds this response. Resume with search_id and an optional cursor without rerunning. Prefer the included JSON download over large inline results.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key and identical arguments after uncertain submission; new work uses a new key.

detail.description: Prefer summary and the complete JSON download; full is a bounded inline fallback.

tools.name: import_media
tools.title: Import media
tools.description: Import media without analysis, inspect an existing import, or retry failed files where supported. Provide root files or source for new media; omit both to open the picker. destination selects its library. Use import_id alone to inspect progress, outputs_cursor/failures_cursor for pages. Retry with retry=true and an idempotency_key; optional files renew expired attachment descriptors using the original file_ids. For failed analysis intake, use its analysis_id as import_id and follow the returned get_analysis action. Source, destination, prompt and title remain unchanged. Keep the returned import_id; analysis can later use source.import_id.

tools.name: save_prompt
tools.title: Save prompt
tools.description: Generate a reusable prompt from instruction or save an explicit definition. Supply prompt_id to update an owned prompt. save defaults to true; save=false returns a draft without persistence. Definitions contain extraction schemas and optional saved execution/selection settings. Reuse the same idempotency_key when retrying a save.

processing_model.description: Model ID published by the billing pricing API.

selection_filter.description: Optional schema-bound selection after extraction. At most four conditions total. Fields and types must match the corresponding segment or video schema.

tools.name: browse
tools.title: Browse media resources
tools.description: Read indexes, videos, analyses, imports, or prompts. Choose resource first; optional ids select exact records and page_size/cursor paginate. name filters indexes/videos/prompts. index_id or index_name scopes videos/analyses/imports. video_ids filters analyses; status filters analyses/imports; include_defaults and active_only apply only to prompts. No creation, retries, exports, or webhook administration.
